scope.description: Five-replica, single-threaded, non-durable slow-path producer and local acceptor recovery-report probe.
assumptions: Empty initialization mirrors constructor state with bounded arrays and in-memory writers; production listeners, clocks and workers are omitted.
N=5, F=2, Thrifty=true. No instances, protocol messages or phase status are injected. Client proposals and a local recovery request are supplied at their interfaces.
The conflicting proposal at peer 1 remains in progress with its outbound traffic delayed.

basis.prefix: Propose B at peer 1 and A at peer 0 on the same key. Deliver A preaccepts to peers 1 and 2 and their actual replies back to peer 0. Differing attributes cause the production slow transition and bcastAccept. Deliver those Accept messages, decode actual acknowledgments, sample acceptor status, and request Prepare using a fresh peer 3 recovery producer to inspect reported status.
basis.requirement: An acceptor that handles a matching, non-stale Accept and emits its successful ballot acknowledgment must retain and report the accepted phase, so recovery can distinguish it from mere preacceptance.
basis.responsibility: Local Accept processing and Prepare report phase preservation, before any assertion about a quorum or distributed safety consequence.

comparisons.description: A later Prepare should report ACCEPTED after the matching successful Accept acknowledgment, with no intervening Commit or new PreAccept.
